title: eleocharis obtusa var. lanceolata
intro: Eleocharis obtusa var. lanceolata, commonly known as Spike-rush, is a type of aquatic plant belonging to the Cyperaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, such as treating respiratory issues, wounds, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Spike-rush include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which help in soothing and protecting the affected areas. The bioactive constituents of Spike-rush include flavonoids, terpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
